scope: APP-077 documented ECS RunTask overrides for the optional OperatorTask. Each `overrides` value is the complete RunTask `overrides` member. It carries only `command`, which ECS passes to the task definition's entryPoint; never environment, credentials, endpoints or SQL.

overrides.name: verify-catalog
overrides.purpose: Read-only catalog proof; the task definition's default command.

overrides.name: verify-catalog-baseline
overrides.purpose: APP-078: read-only proof that the live database equals one reviewed earlier catalog (here version 1, the deployed APP-007 baseline) and is in origin replication mode, before any snapshot or migration.

overrides.name: migrate
overrides.purpose: Canonical apply_migrations for every landed migration; a repeat is unchanged.

overrides.name: seed
overrides.purpose: tenant_seed.seed with validated envelopes in one transaction; exact-match idempotent.

overrides.name: upload-sources-plan
overrides.purpose: Normalize and digest the fixture source; no AWS call.

overrides.name: upload-sources
overrides.purpose: Write the ADR-009 B1 objects with SSE-KMS under the tenant key and print the real digests.

overrides.name: admission-backfill-northstar
overrides.purpose: Genesis audit heads for an existing organization (D7.7).

overrides.name: admission-backfill-canary
overrides.purpose: Genesis audit heads for an existing organization (D7.7).

overrides.name: admission-verify-northstar
overrides.purpose: Recompute every audit chain of the organization.

overrides.name: admission-verify-canary
overrides.purpose: Recompute every audit chain of the organization.

overrides.name: admission-list-northstar
overrides.purpose: Codes, status and counts; never a secret.

overrides.name: admission-revoke
overrides.purpose: Revoke a code by id (the id shown is an example of the exact shape).

overrides.name: admission-extend
overrides.purpose: Move a code's expiry later (the id shown is an example of the exact shape).

overrides.name: admission-defaults
overrides.purpose: Print the reviewed admission defaults; no database connection.

overrides.name: admission-provision
overrides.purpose: Create an organization with its provider tenant binding and five genesis heads (D7.7); prints the non-secret sign-in handle (ADR-006). The values shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-bind-provider-tenant
overrides.purpose: APP-078 B1 (review m5): bind an existing (seeded) organization to its real provider tenant for the token issuer, taking the one (issuer, tenant) pair the organization has in the stack's AuthConfiguration secret (GENUI_AUTH_CONFIGURATION_SECRET_ID, which the operator role reads), so no identifier travels in the override and the registry and the database agree by construction. Refuses a pair already active for another organization (m6). Idempotent; no audit event (D7.8's operator kinds are closed; APP-084 item 6). The organization shown is Northstar; the Canary form sets --organization.

overrides.name: admission-create-app
overrides.purpose: An app shell and its owner's edit_definition grant (ADR-007 amendment of 2026-10-29). The ids shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-grant-permission
overrides.purpose: One row of the closed GRANTABLE set (the S05 builder's path); the app/work/source arguments follow the permission's resource. The ids shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-revoke-permission
overrides.purpose: Remove one GRANTABLE row and advance the member's epoch. The ids shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-revoke-creator-authority
overrides.purpose: End a saved work's creator authority and advance the creator's epoch. The ids shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-revoke-membership
overrides.purpose: Revoke a member (D7.1 order). The ids shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-revoke-entitlement
overrides.purpose: Revoke a member's entitlement (D7.1 order). The ids shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-issue-handle
overrides.purpose: The first live sign-in handle of an organization that has none (ADR-006); prints the non-secret handle. `--handle` installs an exact, already-issued handle and may be omitted to draw a fresh one. The values shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-rotate-handle
overrides.purpose: Rotation step 1: a second live handle beside the current one; prints the non-secret new handle (ADR-006).

overrides.name: admission-retire-handle
overrides.purpose: Rotation step 2: the named handle stops routing; never the last live one (ADR-006). The handle shown is an example of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-create-bound-work
overrides.purpose: A new saved work at version 1 on the origin work's publication with one input bound to a registered live revision of the same source (APP-012 D1); the seeded work is untouched. The ids shown are examples of the exact shape (the Northstar values of APP-012's production order, with an example new work id).

overrides.name: admission-issue-preminted
overrides.purpose: APP-078 managed channel: record a code the operator minted locally (infra/scripts/window_requests.py mint-code). Only its digest crosses into the task, CloudTrail and the log; the result prints code_id and code_digest, never a secret. Refused with any provider-invitation flag. The digest and grant shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-register-source-revision-inline
overrides.purpose: APP-078 managed channel: APP-012's register-source-revision with upload-sources' printed (non-secret) record inline, checked exactly as the file form. The record shown is an example of the exact shape (its contract digest is a placeholder; use the record upload-sources printed).

overrides.name: admission-issue-managed-invitation
overrides.purpose: ADR-003 amendment 2026-10-30 (managed invitations; APP-076 G2): record a code the operator minted locally (window_requests.py mint-code) together with its server-only provider invitation. The task takes the invitation's address, role, issuer and tenant from the injected OperatorInvitationInput secret's entry for this digest (window_requests.py invitation-input, written immediately before the task and overwritten with {} right after) and the fAuth management key from the injected ProviderManagementKey secret (FormaStack, approval A12); the override, CloudTrail, the log and the output carry only the digest, grants and identifiers, never an address, key or invite_token. Refused with any provider flag in argv. The digest and grant shown are examples of the exact shape.

overrides.name: admission-reconcile
overrides.purpose: Settle pending/unknown provider operations by inspection, propagate code expiry and exhaustion, and end capabilities that can no longer be handed off (APP-073). In a managed task the management configuration is the injected ProviderManagementKey secret; with it unconfigured ({}) the command refuses provider_configuration_missing and writes nothing.

overrides.name: admission-seed-spend-review
overrides.purpose: APP-076 G3 (ADR-010 act 6): seed the Spend Review fixture bundle (contracts/fixtures/impl-2026-10-28.1/spend-review.json, the bytes and digests the seed places in the second fixture organization) into Northstar through the operator seed itself: app shell ...00c9, seeded definition revision ...00cb, publication ...00cc, saved work ...00cd with collection ...00ce, expenses source ...00d2 and the seeded EXP-002 record, labeled a seeded definition. Exact-match idempotent (changed:false on a repeat; a differing row refuses whole); no audit event (D7.8 names none; APP-084 item 6).

not_ecs_overrides.reason: It prints the raw access code once on standard output, and a Fargate task's standard output is the awslogs log group: issuing through ECS would retain the secret in CloudWatch Logs. operator.py refuses it (refused_in_managed_task) whenever ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 or ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI is set, which Fargate always sets. APP-078's managed channel is `issue --code-digest` (documented above): the operator mints the code locally and only its digest enters the task. Locally the command is unchanged.

The invitee's address would travel in the task override, CloudTrail's RunTask parameters and the operator log. Refused in a managed task as above. The managed channel is `issue --code-digest --provider-input-from-secret` (documented above): the address, role, issuer and tenant come from the injected OperatorInvitationInput secret and the management key from the injected ProviderManagementKey secret (ADR-003 amendment 2026-10-30, managed invitations); locally `--provider-email` is unchanged.

It reads upload-sources' printed record from a local file (--record), and a RunTask override carries only the command: it cannot deliver that file to the task's read-only filesystem, and the record exists only after upload-sources prints it. operator.py refuses it in a managed task as above; APP-078's managed channel is `--record-json` (documented above), the same non-secret record inline.
